name: Elevate Reserve
summary: Project, developer (Conscient Infrastructure with Hines), Sector 62 Golf Course Extension Road location, RERA GGM/757/489/2023/101 (101 of 2023), under-construction status, 2 towers / 240 units and carpet sizes 1,765 / 2,346 sq ft are confirmed; starting price Rs 5.63 Cr is within 15% of portal prices (~Rs 6.0-6.3 Cr). Major issue: our possession of March 2028 conflicts with the RERA completion date of 30 October 2030 reported by multiple sources. Land area 5.5 acres is marketed by some sites, but RERA-quoting sources give 4.84 acres.
